title: A Small Agent Image
description: A Dockerfile that installs coding-agent tools into an image and drops root, so the tool and its dependencies stay disposable.

steps.description: The comment names the file `Dockerfile.agent`, and the build starts from the `node:22-slim` base image.
Install `git`, `ripgrep`, `ca-certificates`, and `curl` with apt, then clear the apt lists. The comment says git and ripgrep are what coding agents reach for constantly.

Install the `opencode-ai` CLI globally. The comments say opencode is the course default because it speaks to any OpenAI-compatible backend, so it talks to your host Ollama with no account and no API key.
Install a second agent, Oh My Pi, so you can compare two on one task. The line pipes its install script to `sh` and sets the install directory.
The commented lines list other agents you could install instead: Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Codex, and Aider. The note marks Aider as Python, installed with `pip install aider-chat`.
Create a non-root user `agent`, switch to it with `USER agent`, set `WORKDIR /work`, and default to `bash`. The comment says never run as root inside a container you hand to an agent.
